reviews.product_comments:
I just love the look of this chandelier and feel it’s a great addition to our dining room! However, I’m giving this piece three stars because it may look simple to put together and install but, it was far from it. ￼The small piece that holds the base in place was stuck to the base with paint. My husband had to break down the paint by unscrewing and screwing it back it back on and cut his hand! He didn’t complain but, I was horrified. 
Once it was finally up, it was uneven and it took quite sometime to try and make sure all the arms were even. What we had to do was take off two links from the chain, we were not using, and put them on two candle bases, to even out the chandelier. All in all, we paid just over 100, so I will say you get what you pay for. 
Now that it is up we are happy and love the look but, I would be hesitant to order another light fixture from Wayfair.                        the look! I jupay for
It’s beautiful! Everything I imaged and more! Thank you!
Love it. Exactly what I wanted. If you are looking for a cheaper version of the PotteryBarn one this is basically it. It’s definitely not as well made but for us it does exactly what I need it to do.
Such a lovely chandelier. Doesn't overpower the room. We are pleased - great quality.
This chandelier works perfectly in my living room. It was not too difficult to install. My husband and I did it ourselves! It’s a good looking chandelier for a good price.

Absolutely gorgeous chandelier! So happy with our purchase. It’s a fabulous dupe to a much more expensive designer brand (; We love it so much that we’re going to purchase another one in a larger size to hang in our master bedroom!
My husband installed and it’s a little crooked but that’s not the fault of the manufacturer. A little difficult to install but love it!’
This is a beautiful dining room fixture!  Can’t wait to see it with the room decorated.
The “candlestick” holders for the lights are a bit crooked but overall it’s a nice light.
It’s a beautiful chandelier. Elegant and has weight to it, not flimsy at all. And My husband adores it. Glad to have found it on Wayfair to complete our dining room set up! Easy to install as well.

reviews.product_comments: This rig is simply beautiful and goes great with my decor! Fantastic and affordable! Highly recommend!
Exactly what I was looking for to go under my new kitchen table. Goes well with floor and cushions on chairs.
Sooo pretty! Can’t wait for the rest of my furniture to come in!
Very pretty, medium thickness.  I had to steam out some wrinkles with my iron but very happy with my purchase.

This is an excellent rug, especially for the price. The colors are exactly as pictured in the online photos (the colors look darker in my photos than they actually are). The pile is short but compact. The rug doesn’t feel thin despite the short pile. I would still recommend a rug pad underneath for some extra padding and to help anchor the rug. It does slide some without the pad. I love this rug and highly recommend it to anyone!
I was iffy on the rug at 1st but now that its in...its perfect. The picture was of our Xmas tree but you can see the runner on the stairs.
This rug helps pull everything together.

I’m very pleased!  It’s a great rug for the price and the colors are beautiful!  There’s no padding, so make sure to read the specs!  I placed this over a non skid pad on top of my carpet like it suggests.  I haven’t had any problems with it slipping.  It takes a bit of effort to get the wrinkles out, but that’s expected.  Overall, I’m very happy with my purchase!

The colors of this rug are the perfect contrast for my kitchen/living space.  I needed a splash of color to connect the surrounding cabinets and kitchen island hues. It pulls it all together. For the price it works well and I'm not going to fret if I spill anything on it.
This rug has the exact colors I wanted, and it is the exact size. It’s absolutely beautiful, it completes my room.

display_info.romanceCopy: Warm up your floors with this traditional, coastal-inspired area rug. It features an all-over damask pattern in cream, light blue, and navy hues. Machine-made in Turkey from a stain-resistant synthetic and cotton blend, this area rug is ideal in a busy space thanks to its durable and easy-to-clean synthetic fiber blend. Plus, the medium 0.37" pile height means it's ideal in rooms with heavy foot traffic where you like to relax, like your living room. For extra cushioning, and to keep this rug from slipping, we recommend adding a rug pad underneath.

faqs.question: What does Allstate cover?
faqs.answer: Your item is covered for accidents, common malfunctions, and product failures from normal use. Intentional damage, loss, and theft are not covered.

faqs.question: How do I file a claim?
Do I need to register my plan?
faqs.answer: No, you do not need to register your plan for it to be active. All you need is the receipt for your item.

faqs.question: When does my coverage start?
faqs.answer: Protection plan coverage begins the day your area rug is purchased.

faqs.question: Can I cancel my plan?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can cancel your plan for a full refund in the first 30 days, prorated after that. To cancel your plan, {contactLink} (not Allstate).

faqs.question: Where can I find full Terms & Conditions?
